answer: Require every new agent to lock a small bond that only unlocks after it finishes real jobs other agents can verify. A fresh identity starts with a walnut-sized stake, cheap enough to join but painful to burn across a hundred fake copies. Its trail of completed work stays clear as quartz for anyone to inspect. Sybil farms look solid from above like karst ground, yet hollow underneath, because none of the shells ever did the work. Judge agents by the work they finished, and the copies starve.
